reviews.rationale: Reviewed the complete immutable package. Client fetch targets the own same-origin /composer-keys route; host rejects untrusted callers through connection.requestRejection before any read/write, sanitizes three enum fields, and updates only its own revision-bound settings namespace. No third-party code was executed; runtime acceptance remains unknown.

The current README asserts localhost-only networking. lib/index.js:3216 merges rawConfig without a loopback restriction, while cfg.comfyUrl is passed to fetch in lib/config.js:1895 and lib/index.js:1729-1889. The hipfire child at lib/hipfire-img.js:243 inherits the host environment. The disclosed endpoint/environment boundary is not proved by this fixed source; require enforcement or an accurate broader disclosure before admission.

The complete fixed Host source registers a session inspection/deletion route. handleRecallRequest validates method/content type but does not establish caller authorization before reading the requested Session or invoking runUnderMaintenance. A same-origin browser fetch is not server-side authorization evidence; admission remains blocked pending a verified host trust boundary or fail-closed route check.

Complete fixed-source coverage is verified. Manual admission is rejected because lib/part2.js:2171-2305 registers configuration read/write and broadcast handlers without establishing caller authorization before saveSettings invokes configEditor.edit or before bumpSettingsBroadcast. Same-origin credentials in the client do not establish a server-side trust boundary. A verified host authorization contract or a fail-closed request check is required; capabilities need not be removed.

The ComfyUI startup guard, redirect:error on the three HTTP helpers, and filtered child environment are present. Manual admission remains rejected because lib/hipfire-img.js:456-548 reads configurable cfg.hipfireUrl and issues health/generation/edit requests without assertLocalUrl or the opt-in; guardedFetch has no callers. README:847 also declares no package installation while lib/index.js:247-265 runs pip install via runShell. Enforce or accurately disclose all endpoint and command boundaries; no third-party code was executed.

The destructive-root-delete findings are exact false positives: lib/core.js:2573 and lib/client.core.js:2581 are the same comment before the speech table; the adjacent command literals feed speechLines/pickSpeechLine and textContent sinks in lib/client.js:4080 and lib/desktop-page.js:1175. Their bytes are bound by the dispositions below. This does not grant admission: the packaged asset/ignore surface remains incomplete, license metadata is unresolved, and explicit DSH compatibility is missing.

reviews.rationale: The complete 0.14.0 source reads each candidate session log synchronously before applying the workspace predicate in lib/mine.js scanSessionLogs. The documented read boundary therefore exceeds matching-workspace logs, and readFileSync plus zstdDecompressSync have no per-file or decompressed-byte limit. Scope the read before opening or accurately disclose the broader read, and bound synchronous input/decompression before admission. This review does not require removing the legitimate memory feature.

The complete requested 0.3.0 source writes a real Profile patch in lib/preset-tune.js:225-245. Backup failure is swallowed and persistence continues; the temporary path is shared by every concurrent invocation in the same process, and no precondition check protects edits made after readFile. Atomic rename alone does not provide recoverable concurrent edits. The same persistence structure is independently present at current Catalog 0.5.0, whose single-file evidence is recorded separately, without claiming a full current-package review.
